about: A note for each fix MR whose gate did not pass, written by a person from the job logs. The keys are MR numbers.

notes.1: A fault of the harness, not of the fix: the chroot jobs had no /proc, so ggml loaded no CPU backend (D-022). Fixed, then MR !3 held every floor.
notes.2: EPYC-Milan passed the 2400 s run limit under QEMU, so the judge said cpu inconclusive. Fixed with a smaller audio context (D-027).
notes.4: EPYC-Milan passed the 2400 s run limit, as in MR !2 (D-027).
notes.8: The judge passed. The check job failed: on that main commit, TOOLS_TAG did not match the edited tools recipe. Fixed on main later.
notes.9: The judge passed. The check job failed: on that main commit, a test found old text in two files. Fixed on main later.
